name: channel-less-read-mounts-inline
description: The inline static channel makes a channel-less server mountable: no static component URL is wired, no live channel is wired, but the committed component fits the inline codeB64 cap — so the read returns a shell whose projected render meta declares the inline channel, not a typed failure. This is the success half of the size split whose failure half is read-without-a-delivery-channel-answers-not-mountable: the SAME server wiring answers by component size class, which is what makes the inline channel a real delivery channel rather than a serving detail.
